notes: LIKEs si.Tags, which is NULLABLE. Item 4 (cardboard box) has NULL Tags -> LIKE-on-NULL is never true, so it can never be returned. That is the branch this proc exists to exercise vs SearchForStockItems.

cases.name: gadget-tag-match
cases.why: 'Gadget' tag is on items 1,2,5 -> three rows ordered by name (food warmer, missile, rocket). Note item 4 is absent (NULL Tags).

cases.name: novelty-tag-one
cases.why: 'Novelty' tag is only on item 5 -> single row. Proves multi-tag items match on any contained tag.

cases.name: chocolate-tag-one
cases.why: 'Chocolate' tag is only on item 3 -> single row.

cases.name: cardboard-null-tags-empty
cases.why: 'cardboard' is item 4's name/details but item 4 has NULL Tags -> LIKE-on-NULL fails -> [] . The null-Tags branch: a needle that WOULD match on details returns nothing on tags.

cases.name: top-1-pagination
cases.why: 'Gadget' matches three but TOP(1) returns only the first by name (food warmer).
